frames.observation: Undisturbed ranchland and irrigated pivot fields. No grading, no cleared pads, no access roads, no module arrays anywhere in 6km view.
Same undisturbed character as July 2026. No activity signal at 6 months back. Early-exit rule applied.

cod.rationale: No ground disturbance as of July 2026 (18 months before reported COD). FIS not approved, 'Meets all 6.9' not achieved. A 206 MW solar build requires ~12-18 months from NTP to COD at minimum. Abatement Road Use Agreement filed Jan 2026 = pre-construction permitting, not construction start. COD pulled forward twice from 2029-07 to 2027-12-31 reflects developer ambition, not observed progress. Most likely scenario: construction start mid-2026 → COD late 2028. If FIS delays, slip to 2029 is possible.

cod_drift_history.note: Both COD changes are pull-forwards (2029→2028→2027), unusual direction. Combined with no construction visible, this suggests schedule ambition driven by permitting completions (IA Feb 2025, abatement amendment Jan 2026), not actual construction progress.
